claim.binary_failure_condition: The residual quantity is wrong, cover exceeds the remaining gap, the balance is hidden or misclassified, or the required owner and follow-up action are absent or incorrect.
claim.binary_pass_condition: The residual shortfall equals the post-cure deficiency less eligible executed cover, is not silently treated as accepted or covered, and is assigned a clear responsible owner and follow-up action as of the cutoff.
candidate_evidence_requirements: A residual-shortfall calculation tied to the deficiency and cover records, plus an owner and operational follow-up field.
claim.description: The workpaper calculates the remaining uncovered certificate shortfall only after seller cure and eligible executed buyer cover are exhausted.
claim.independent_failure_mode: The accepted-seller and executed-cover quantities can be correct while the uncovered residual and its operational consequence are independently wrong.
claim.title: Residual shortfall follows cure and cover

predicates.counterexample: A workspace showing 960 accepted and the same USD 16,920 payable fails conservation.
evidence_requirements: Inspect contract facts, delivery ranges, registry periods and custody, export metadata, inventory formulas, and AP arithmetic.
predicates.pass_condition: The LOT-A, LOT-B, and REPL-C periods and custody facts match their exact identities; the scheduled export ends at 09:30; 400+150+250+150=950; 1000-950=50; 50-40=10; 950*18=17100; 40*(22.50-18)=180; 17100-180-0=16920.
predicates.statement: All frozen quantities, prices, times, interval endpoints, lifecycle inputs, and conservation equations agree.

route_context.business_goal: Close the seller's 2024 Class I delivery without paying for unusable certificates and preserve a supportable compliance inventory.
route_context.deliverable_class: Auditable certificate-delivery settlement workbook with embedded procurement and accounting decision summary
difficulty_sources: Temporal qualification and lifecycle precedence across different systems
Pixel-essential reversal and overlap evidence whose raw baselines and dimension-preserved annotations traverse two independently auditable PDF-to-DOCX chains
Visual trade-to-allocation-to-registry custody handoff that separates executed cover damages from buyer-held compliance inventory
As-of qualification-exception event precedence after exact unit authority matching and before downstream settlement propagation
route_context.natural_request_context: A settlement manager needs a single spreadsheet workpaper for the procurement director and controller after the final tender arrived on June 9.
route_context.terminal_decision: After admitting the reversal and overlap only from the two raw-plus-marked cross-document evidence pairs, approve USD 16,920 net payable; post 950 seller RECs and 40 cover RECs separately; dispute 50 seller RECs, record a 10-REC residual shortfall, send dispute by June 16, and preserve July 1 filing readiness.
route_context.unique_resolution: Exact source precedence, inclusive serial arithmetic, lifecycle event order, signed cure hierarchy, cover execution, paired raw/derived lineage admissibility, and conservation equations admit only the stated quantities, payable, and deadlines. The cover inventory component additionally requires an exact trade-to-allocation-to-final-registry-custody match by the cutoff; absent that final handoff, the cover posting is zero and the residual is fifty while the damage offset remains unchanged. The otherwise valid LOT-D unit must additionally have QX-38983-2025 in a final released state by noon; a pending, late, or mismatched release withholds its 150 certificates from the close and forces the stated downstream quantity, payable, inventory, and residual counterfactual.

rules.counterexample: Applying buyer cover before considering timely REPL-B violates the amendment.
rules.resolution_order: Original test; timely seller cure; unique substitute test; buyer cover; residual shortfall.
rules.statement: Determine original deficiency, apply timely valid seller substitutions by June 6, then allow buyer cover only for the remaining gap, and carry any uncovered balance as residual shortfall.
truth_conditions: Cure election scans prove case EXC-24017 was elected at 16:41.
Cover quantity does not exceed post-cure deficiency.

rules.counterexample: A residual of zero would require ten unsupported certificates.
rules.resolution_order: Accepted seller components, contract cap, post-cure deficiency, cover cap, residual.
rules.statement: Accepted seller quantity equals 400 LOT-A plus 150 LOT-D plus 250 REPL-B plus 150 unique REPL-C; deficiency equals 1,000 less accepted, and residual equals deficiency less executed cover.
truth_conditions: The 40 cover is executed and no other cure exists by noon.

rules.counterexample: A quote screenshot without a matching executed broker blotter is not cover.
rules.resolution_order: Cross-image identity; execution state; time window; quantity cap; price.
rules.statement: A cover trade counts only when terminal and broker views agree on trade ID, executed status, product, quantity, price, and time after cure expiry but by the cutoff.
truth_conditions: Both views identify BRK-88402, forty, USD 22.50, and executed.

rules.counterexample: Deducting the entire USD 900 cover cost rather than its USD 180 differential fails.
rules.resolution_order: Accepted gross; cover differential capped by deficiency; other supported credits; net payable.
rules.statement: Gross payable is accepted seller quantity times USD 18; recoverable cover offset is executed cover times positive USD 22.50 minus USD 18 differential; net payable is gross less offset and prior credits.
truth_conditions: No prior payment or credit exists.

rules.counterexample: Posting 990 as seller delivery loses the separate cover lineage.
rules.resolution_order: Seller settled quantity; cover quantity; unresolved errant quantity; residual check.
rules.statement: Post accepted seller certificates and buyer cover as separate current-year Class I components; their sum plus residual must reconcile to the 1,000 close requirement.
truth_conditions: No rejected or duplicate lot enters settled certificates.

rules.counterexample: Using July 1 as the invoice dispute deadline fails.
rules.resolution_order: Contract clock first for dispute; regulation independently for filing.
rules.statement: The buyer's five-business-day dispute clock starts on the first business day after final tender and excludes weekends, yielding June 16 at 17:00 EDT; regulatory filing remains July 1.
truth_conditions: June 10, 11, 12, 13, and 16 are the five counted business days.
